specs.label: Battery connection
specs.value: One each positive and negative terminal, applicable cable diameter: AWG 6 – AWG 0 (AWG 1/0) (16 mm2 – 50 mm2); Line resistance within 4 mΩ / total

specs.label: Charging output voltage
specs.value: 27.3 V ±0.3 V (at 25 ˚C), Temperature correction coefficient: -40 mV/ ˚C

specs.label: Control connector
specs.value: RJ45 female connector for connecting the system and cascade connection; Shielded Twisted-pair straight cable (TIA/EIA-568A standard)

specs.label: DS LINK IN/OUT
specs.value: Type of control signal: Battery check, AC power status, DC power status, charging circuit failure, battery failure, and communication

specs.label: Panel indicator
specs.value: AC power IN 1, Charging (Green), Battery power (Green), Battery connect (Green), Battery condition (Green)

specs.label: Power / current consumption
specs.value: Approx. 1460 W max. (at rated output with charging), 460 W (EN 60065)
